newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares weaker on EMU worries.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares weaker on EMU worries.

text.p: Italian shares closed mostly weaker on Tuesday, hit by a bout of nerves after the announcement of a French election cast a shadow over progress towards EMU.
The all-share Mibtel index finished 0.38 percent lower at 12,252 with the blue chip Mib30 closing 0.35 percent down at 18,260.
ENI was stable at 8,870 lire while Fiat shed 2.48 percent to 5,575 lire after San Paolo announced it was buying 2.2 percent of the car company at 5,700 lire per share, to be paid next January.
Traders said that the agreed purchase price had dampened sentiment towards Fiat.
Insurers were weaker with Generali easing 1.69 percent to 29,850 lire, Alleanza down 1.43 percent to 12,240 lire and RAS down 1.97 percent to 14,650 lire.
BCI closed 1.73 percent higher at 3,580 lire, lifted by continued talk of a possible linkup with Mediobanca and switching out of Credito which closed 0.85 percent lower at 2,340 lire.
